rationale: Blautia hydrogenotrophica ferments glucose and lactate under anaerobic conditions. Glucose is the preferred substrate (20 mmol/gDW/h uptake). Mixed fermentation yields acetate as the dominant product with formate, H₂, and CO₂. Growth rate of 0.35/h is supported by 38 mmol C/gDW biomass requirement and adequate nitrogen from ammonium. Carbon balance: 25 C (glucose) + 3 C (lactate) = 28 C in; 13.3 C (biomass) + 14.7 C (products) = 28 C out. Nitrogen: 3 mmol N/gDW/h uptake supports 0.35/h × 10 mmol N/gDW growth requirement.
